title: OptiPrune User Configuration
description: Configuration schema for optiprune.json and optiprune.jsonc files.

$schema.description: URL to the JSON schema for validation and autocompletion.

rootDir.description: The root directory of the project source code relative to the workspace.

entry.description: Array of entry-point files. Files listed here and their dependency chains will be protected from unused symbol pruning.

extensions.description: File extensions OptiPrune will process during analysis. Replaces the default list when provided.

ignore.description: Glob patterns or path segments to exclude from analysis. Use this to ignore entire folders (e.g., '**/tests/**'), specific files (e.g., '**/*.spec.ts'), or build artifacts. These patterns are appended to the built-in defaults like node_modules and dist.

ignoreDependencies.description: npm package names that OptiPrune should never flag as unused, regardless of whether they appear in import statements. Useful for packages used via global injection or peer dependencies.

externalContracts.description: List of public symbols or interfaces exported for external consumers to prevent OptiPrune from flagging them as unused.

reportUnusedExports.description: When true, flags exported symbols that are never imported elsewhere in the project.

includeConventionalEntries.description: Automatically recognizes framework conventions (e.g., index.ts, main.js, App.tsx) as entry points.

failOn.description: Minimum finding severity level that causes the execution process to exit with a non-zero code.

verbose.description: Enables detailed step-by-step diagnostic logging during execution.

fix.description: When true, automatically applies fixes for certain findings (e.g., removing 'export' keyword from unused exports).

output.description: Output format for analysis results. 'terminal' produces human-readable coloured output; 'json' emits machine-readable JSON to stdout; 'sarif' emits SARIF 2.1 JSON for IDE and CI integrations.

json.description: Deprecated. Use 'output: "json"' instead. When true, outputs analysis findings in raw JSON format to stdout.

rules.description: Map of rule names to their severity level overrides.

plugins.description: Explicit enable/disable overrides for individual plugins. Use the plugin's name string as the key. Setting a value to false disables the plugin even if its auto-detection would enable it; setting it to true forces it on regardless of detection.

layers.description: Advanced engine layer settings for execution and solver layers.

smtTimeoutMs.description: Maximum time limit in milliseconds allocated to the SMT solver per proof attempt.

isolateMemoryLimitMb.description: Maximum V8 isolate heap memory limit in Megabytes allocated per worker thread.

enableConcolicProof.description: Enables concolic execution engine for deep reachability and dead-path proofs.

skip3.description: Skips Execution Layer 3 (SMT/Z3 solver) pass during analysis.

skip4.description: Skips Execution Layer 4 (node:vm sandbox) pass during analysis.
